descriptionChirho: Substantivized participle (Qal or Piel) denoting a person stationed as a lookout or guard, including singular, plural, and construct forms with articles, conjunctions, and pronominal suffixes.
Qal verbal forms (finite and participial) meaning to keep watch, observe, or stand guard over something or someone.
Piel stem expressing intensive or eager watching — looking out with anticipation, expectation, or sustained attention toward what is coming.
Watching with hostile or predatory intent, as when the wicked lurks in ambush against the righteous.
Qal passive participle indicating someone or something that has been appointed, assigned, or destined for a particular role or outcome.
